verdict.rationale: Docs describe a web interface where users can 'review diffs visually, run multiple sessions side by side, schedule recurring tasks, and kick off cloud sessions,' plus the ability to spawn multiple coordinated agents or run multiple tasks in parallel — directly supporting a unified multi-session workspace. However, this is vendor-claimed only, with no independent/community evidence validating the quality or reliability of managing multiple concurrent sessions, and most community feedback focuses on unrelated code-quality and trust issues.
